---
title: Backlinks
type: concept
---

Every page that a wikilink resolves to gets a "Backlinks" section appended
automatically, at render time: a list of every other page that links to
it. You're reading one of the two source pages behind this page's own
backlinks section right now. Both this page and [[The Graph Widget]] link
here from [[quarto-graph|the home page]] and each other, so scroll to the
bottom of either one to see the list build up.

Nothing about this "Backlinks" section lives in this file. It's injected
into the page live, by a Pandoc Lua filter, at your own render time, and
never gets written into this `.qmd` source.

For example, this page's own appended section (as rendered, not as
written here) looks like:

```markdown
## Backlinks

- [The Graph Widget](../the-graph-widget/index.qmd)
- [quarto-graph](../index.qmd)
```

The list is sorted by title, and only includes pages reached through a
resolved wikilink. A plain Markdown link (`[text](url)`) written
directly, bypassing the wikilink syntax entirely, does not count and
creates no backlink. This also means it does not create an edge in
[[The Graph Widget]]. Graph edges and backlinks are generated from the
same scan over the same resolved wikilinks, so they always agree with
each other by construction, not by coincidence.
